privacyIntro: Transcendence is a project developed for educational purposes as part of ft_transcendence, belonging to the common core of school 42 Barcelona. This policy describes in simple terms how we handle data in the application.
dataCollect1: Email, username, and password (stored encrypted) to create and manage your account.
dataCollect2: Avatar (optional), stored and served via an external image hosting provider (Cloudinary).
dataCollect3: Game usage data (matches, results, friends) needed for the application to work.
dataUse1: To allow registration, login, and password recovery.
dataUse2: To display your profile (username, avatar) and manage your friends list.
dataUse3: To enable online matches, matchmaking, and local play.
dataShare1: Data is used within the project. We do not sell or give your data to third parties for commercial purposes.
dataShare2: Your avatar images are stored and delivered by Cloudinary; see "Third-party services" below.
dataShare3: In an academic context, the project may be reviewed by teaching staff or other students for assessment or educational purposes.
thirdPartyIntro: The application loads resources from external providers. Those providers may receive technical data (such as your IP address, browser type, and the fact that you requested a resource) in accordance with their own privacy policies.
thirdPartyCloudinary: We use Cloudinary to store and serve profile avatars (including a default avatar). When you view the site or upload an avatar, your browser may request images from Cloudinary.
thirdPartyGoogleFonts: We use Google Fonts to load typography (e.g. the "Share Tech Mono" font). When you load our pages, your browser may request font files from Google's servers.
thirdPartyBlocking: If your browser blocks "tracking content" or third-party resources, fonts and avatars may not load correctly and the site's appearance or some features may be affected. You can manage this in your browser's privacy or protection settings.
protectText: Passwords are stored with secure hashing; communication uses HTTPS; we offer optional two-factor verification (2FA).
rightsText: You can request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting:
rightsDelete: If you delete your account, your email and associated data are permanently removed from our systems. Avatar images stored with Cloudinary are removed in line with our data deletion process.
termsIntro: Transcendence is an educational project. By using the application you accept these terms.
termsUseText: Transcendence is an online game with user accounts, matches (online, local, vs bot), matchmaking, and friends. By using it you agree to these terms.
termsResponsibilityText: You are responsible for the activity on your account and for using the service in a respectful manner. Keep your password confidential.
termsProhibitionsText: Do not misuse the service, attempt to disrupt or alter it, or access it in an unauthorized way.
termsThirdPartyText1: The service depends on external providers for certain features. We use Cloudinary to store and serve profile avatars, and Google Fonts to display typography. If your browser blocks tracking or third-party content, fonts and avatars may not load and the site's appearance or functionality may be affected. We do not control these providers' availability or their terms.
termsThirdPartyText2: User content (avatars) that you upload is stored with Cloudinary. You retain ownership of your content and grant us the rights needed to display it within the application. Use of Cloudinary is subject to their terms and conditions; we are not responsible for their practices.
termsConsequencesText: Accounts may be suspended or removed if these terms are violated.
termsEducationalText: This service is an academic project. It may be modified or discontinued at any time.
